figure.alt: Four side-view diagrams of a horizontal rod suspended by two threads from a fixed support. Diagram 1: vertical parallel threads with length l and spacing h labelled, arrow showing rotation of the rod. Diagram 2: threads crossed into contact, labelled N = 0. Diagram 3: threads twisted together, labelled N, t = 0. Diagram 4: crossed threads with rod at lower position, labelled N = 0, t = T.

Vertical ruler-like scale: on the left the axis N (arrow upward) with ticks 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30; on the right the axis k (arrow downward) with ticks 0, 5, 10, 15; the mark N = 30 coincides with k = 0.
Graph k(t): smoothly curving line with experimental points from k = 0 to k = 30 for t from 0 to ~46.5 s; axes are t, s (0–60) and k (0–33).
Graph of E(k), Ku versus k (0–33) with four series of points and smoothing curves labelled №1, №2, №3, №4; E rises from 0 to about 0,86 Ku.
Graph of ln t versus ln k (ln k from 0,0 to 3,5; ln t from 2,0 to 4,0) with the experimental points and the straight line y = 0,684x + 1,500.
Interval 35-25: graph of ln t versus ln k (0,0–2,5; 1,0–3,6) with points and the fit line y = 0,6748x + 1,4938.
Interval 30-20: graph of ln t versus ln k (0,0–2,5; 1,0–3,8) with points and the fit line y = 0,6654x + 1,5638.
Interval 25-15: graph of ln t versus ln k (0,0–2,5; 1,0–3,8) with points and the fit line y = 0,6751x + 1,6012.
Interval 20-10: graph of ln t versus ln k (0,0–2,5; 1,0–3,8) with points and the fit line y = 0,673x + 1,6844.
Interval 15-5: graph of ln t versus ln k (0,0–2,5; 1,0–3,8) with points and the fit line y = 0,6765x + 1,7759.
Interval 10-0: graph of ln t versus ln k (0,0–2,5; 1,0–3,8) with points and the fit line y = 0,6498x + 1,9472.
Graph of ln T versus ln N (ln N from 1,5 to 3,5; ln T from 3,0 to 4,0) with six measured points and the fit line y = 0,4473x + 2,3811.
